tickets.title: Modules as items in a layout slot

authority.locator: P02 · Modules as items in a layout slot, section A; extraction G-B (C1)
authority.requirement: modules are registered with their ID, kind and journey stages. A page's layout is declared as one slot of K positions over M ≥ K registered modules. The decision returns up to K module IDs in ranked order, with eligibility, exclusions and de-duplication applied; **a module not returned is not drawn, and layout slots are measured on `rendered-v1` so a module that is not drawn is not an exposure.** **Amended 2026-10-07 (extraction G-B, C1):** the earlier wording "returns all N" never exercised selection, which is Mandeep's first problem (which modules show at all). Fixed-size selection is built today through `take`; this ticket makes it the declared contract and names what the front end does with a module that is not returned.

tickets.outcome: A page's layout is one declared slot of K positions over M registered modules, M at least K, and each decision on both hosts returns up to K module identifiers in rank order with eligibility, exclusions and page-wide de-duplication applied, measured on rendered-v1 so that a module which is not drawn is not an exposure, with the contract stated in the kit.

tickets.title: Signal floor

authority.locator: P10 · Signal floor, section B; extraction G-B and G-C
authority.requirement: a per-tenant N, overridable per slot, with "never" allowed on a layout slot. Below N signals the shopper gets the default or context-configured decision, and the first personalized response lands on action N + 1. Existing tenants default to 0, so W16.C8.04 still holds (R87(e)). **Amended 2026-10-07 (extraction G-B, G-C):** per-slot so that a layout can stay context-only while content slots personalize, which is what makes the layout cacheable per context key (P30).
